newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange volume surges on arbitrage.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange volume surges on arbitrage.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange soared to 2,045 kilos on Tuesday from Monday's 1,240 kilos as banks engaged heavily in arbitrage and on continuing physical demand, dealers said.

Gold closed slightly firmer at $349.20 an ounce and 1,539,500 lira per gram, compared to $349.00 and 1,533,300 lira on Monday, in line with movements on European markets where gold met resistance at $350.
The Turkish lira closed easier at 137,000 lira to the dollar versus 136,450 on Monday, enabling banks to conduct arbitrage deals.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,805 kilos -- took place in the morning session, and 54.5 percent of the total was in lira terms.
